annotations.title: Does this set-aside contractor do its own work?

description: One set-aside contractor (name or UEI): set-aside obligations by year, what was bought (labor, R&D, SaaS, travel, construction, products), its own Form 5500 workforce (active participants, EIN, EFAST2 ACK_ID, plan type, union/multiemployer flag, parent's headcount, largest same-name sponsor nationwide), labor dollars per participant against peers, flag tier and explanation codes, FSRS subawards and ontology rules. Free. full=true with a Tensorust key adds the case file: every award (office, PSC, offers, SBIR code, end date, subawards), every 5500 filing and the citations (13 CFR 125.6, FAR 52.219-14, VAAR 852.219-75, 13 CFR 121.103(h)).

full.description: true adds the case file; needs a Tensorust key (Authorization: Bearer tdk_...).
